translations.idiomatic: Also Regular Attendant, envoy to Song.

sentences.zh: 進爵為侯。

translations.literal: Advanced to marquis.
translations.idiomatic: Advanced to marquis.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡曰文恭。

translations.literal: At death posthumous name Marquis Wengong.
translations.idiomatic: He died. Posthumous name Marquis Wengong.

sentences.zh: 子怡襲爵，位荊州刺史，賜爵南陽公。

translations.literal: His son Yi inherited the title, held the post of Inspector of Jing, and was granted Duke of Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Son Yi inherited, was Inspector of Jing, Duke of Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 子侍，孝文賜名述，位齊州刺史。

translations.literal: His son Shi; Xiaowen granted the name Shu and he held the post of Inspector of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Son Shi. Xiaowen granted the name Shu. He was Inspector of Qi.

sentences.zh: 初改置百官，始重公府元佐，以述為太傅元丕長史。

translations.literal: At the first reorganization of the hundred offices, the chief aide to the grand tutor was newly prized; Shu was made Chief Clerk to Grand Tutor Yuan Pi.
translations.idiomatic: At the first reorganization of offices the grand tutor's chief aide was prized anew. Shu was Chief Clerk to Grand Tutor Yuan Pi.

sentences.zh: 座于司空長史。

translations.literal: He sat as Chief Clerk to the Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He sat as Chief Clerk to the Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 諡曰貞。

translations.literal: Posthumous name Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous name Zhen.

sentences.zh: 論曰：昭成、道武之時，雲雷方始，至於經邦緯俗，文武兼資。

translations.literal: Discussion says: In the times of Zhaocheng and Daowu, clouds and thunder were just beginning; as for ordering the realm and weaving custom, men combined civil and martial worth.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: In the age of Zhaocheng and Daowu, clouds and thunder were rising. To order the realm and weave custom took men of civil and martial gift together.

sentences.zh: 燕鳳博識多聞，首膺禮命。

translations.literal: Yan Feng was broadly learned and many-hearing; he was first to receive ritual appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Feng was broad in learning and hearing; he was first to receive ritual appointment.

sentences.zh: 許謙才術俱美，驅馳艱虞。

translations.literal: Xu Qian's talent and art were together fine, galloping through hardship and peril.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Qian's talent and craft were fine together, galloping through hardship and peril.

sentences.zh: 不然，何以成帝業也。

translations.literal: Otherwise, how could imperial enterprise be achieved?
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise how could imperial enterprise stand?

sentences.zh: 崔宏家世雋偉，仍屬權輿，總機任重，守正成務，禮從清廟，固其宜也。

translations.literal: The Cui Hong clan's household was lofty across generations; still amid the founding of power, he bore the weight of the pivot, kept rectitude and completed tasks—rite following the clear temple, as was fitting.
translations.idiomatic: The Cui Hong house was lofty for generations. In the founding hour Hong bore the pivot, kept rectitude and finished the work—rites for the clear temple, as was fitting.

sentences.zh: 浩才藝通博，究覽天文，政事籌策，時莫之二。

translations.literal: Hao's arts and learning penetrated broadly; he thoroughly viewed astronomy; in governing affairs and stratagem, none of the time was second to him.
translations.idiomatic: Hao's arts ran broad; he mastered astronomy; in counsel and statecraft none stood second.

sentences.zh: 此其所以自比於子房焉。

translations.literal: This is why he compared himself to Zifang.
translations.idiomatic: This is why he likened himself to Zifang.

sentences.zh: 屬明元為政之秋，太武經營之日，言聽計從，甯廓區夏，遇既深矣，勤亦茂哉。

translations.literal: In the autumn of Mingyuan's government and the days of Taiwu's campaigning, his words were heard and plans followed; he tranquilly swept the central land; the favor shown was already deep, the diligence already luxuriant.
translations.idiomatic: In Mingyuan's autumn and Taiwu's campaigning days his words were heard and plans obeyed. He swept the central land. Favor was deep; diligence was rich.

sentences.zh: 謀雖蓋世，威未震主，末途邂逅，遂不自全。

translations.literal: Though stratagem covered the age, his awe had not shaken the ruler; at the end of the road chance struck, and he could not preserve himself.
translations.idiomatic: Though stratagem covered the age, his awe never shook the throne. At the road's end chance struck—and he could not save himself.

sentences.zh: 豈鳥盡弓藏，人惡其上，將器盈必概，陰害貽禍，何斯人而遭斯酷乎？

translations.literal: Was it that when birds are gone the bow is stored, men hate the one above them—or that when the vessel fills it must be leveled, hidden harm brings calamity—why did such a man meet such cruelty?
translations.idiomatic: Was it birds gone, bow stored—men hate the heights? Vessel full, must be leveled—hidden harm brings ruin? Why did such a man meet such cruelty?

sentences.zh: 至若張袞才策，不免其戾，彥海貞白，禍非其罪，亦足痛云。

translations.literal: As for Zhang Gun's talent and stratagem, he could not escape a harsh end; Yanhai's pure whiteness, disaster not for his crime—pain enough to tell.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Gun's talent could not escape a harsh end. Yanhai's pure whiteness—disaster not for his crime. Pain enough to tell.

sentences.zh: 洪讓世著循吏，家風良可貴矣。

translations.literal: Hongrang was famous through the age as an upright official; his household style is truly worthy to prize.
translations.idiomatic: Hongrang was famed through the age as an upright official. His household style is worth prizing.
